learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how to borrow beautiful colors from Mother Nature to create stunning and eco-friendly works of art!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Long before plastic paint tubes existed, artists found their colors outside! They ground up colorful rocks, squeezed bright berries, and boiled bright yellow turmeric roots to create beautiful, natural pigments.
Nature offers more than just color it offers amazing textures! You can create wonderful art by rubbing a crayon over a bumpy dried leaf or pressing a rough piece of tree bark onto soft clay.
Using Nature's Palette is a wonderful way to be an eco-friendly artist. By using natural dyes and recycled materials, we create beautiful masterpieces while keeping our precious Earth safe and clean.

fun_activity.title: ☕ The Coffee Wash Masterpiece
fun_activity.instructions: Ask an adult for a few spoons of leftover plain black coffee or tea. Dip a soft brush into the liquid and paint a beautiful, warm brown landscape on a thick piece of white paper!

quick_recap: ⭐ Mother Nature provides a brilliant palette of colors hidden inside everyday flowers, spices, and vegetables.
⭐ Creating art with natural materials connects us deeply to the environment and teaches us to be eco-friendly.
